milestones.title: Root of All Trust
milestones.joke: You fetched the CA's root certificate.
milestones.when: shell: `step certificate inspect /opt/step-ca-root/root_ca.crt` (or `step certificate ...` on the root file), exit 0

milestones.title: Fingerprint Frisk
milestones.joke: Checked the fingerprint, like a suspicious bouncer.
milestones.when: shell: `step certificate fingerprint` or `openssl x509 ... -fingerprint`, exit 0

milestones.title: Now We Trust You
milestones.joke: The system trusts the CA. Do not tell your bank.
milestones.when: shell: `step ca bootstrap` exit 0 (the trust step; whether the bootstrap really wrote a usable config is not checked)

milestones.title: Trust Issues, Resolved
milestones.joke: certbot and acme.sh trust it too, separately.
milestones.when: shell: `acme.sh` run with `--ca-bundle` (exit 0) after certbot has issued (which Lab 2 does with `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE`); the tools' config files are not read
